text:
shreya: Hey infra team, can we provision a new GPU node pool in us-west3 for burst inference traffic? Need mixed capacity for latency-sensitive routes (small requests) and heavy-batch jobs. Thinking: 8 x a10g (1 GPU) + 2 x h100 (4 GPU) as a starting point. Prefer spot/preemptible mix for a10g and reserved for h100. :thinking_face:

mike: Do we have quota in us-west3 for those SKUs? Last time quotas were tight there. Also cluster-autoscaler config needs max nodes per pool.

anya: +1 on quota check. I tried creating a small a10g pool yesterday and hit: `error: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded. requested=8, available=0` — cloud console shows 0 available vGPUs for a10g in us-west3.

kevin: If quota is 0 we need to open a support request with the cloud provider. I can file it but need exact SKU and project id. Which project will this live in?

shreya: Project: redwood-prod-infer-usw3. SKUs: a10g-standard-1 (1xA10G), h100-4g (4xH100) — label pools accordingly. I'll post a minimal CA (cluster-autoscaler) snippet after.

capacity-bot: FYI: Current cluster-autoscaler flags: `--expander=least-waste --balance-similar-node-groups=true --max-node-provision-time=20m` and pools have `maxNodes: 200` by default.

mike: Suggested CA changes for mixed SKUs: set expander to `priority` with node-group priorities so latency pool (a10g spot) is preferred for small inference. Also add `--skip-nodes-with-system-pods=false` to avoid scheduling surprises for GPU DS.

anya: Also remember GPU driver DaemonSet (nvidia-gpu-drivers) had kernel mismatch on one of our custom images last month. We should pin the node image family (cos-containerd-100-xx) or use node pool upgrade strategy `maxUnavailable: 1`.

shreya: Proposed nodepool config (high level):
```
nodePool: gw-usw3-a10g-spot
instanceType: a10g-standard-1
preemptible: true
minNodes: 0
maxNodes: 40
taints: gpu=latency:NoSchedule
labels: workload=low-latency
```
And:
```
nodePool: gw-usw3-h100-reserved
instanceType: h100-4g
preemptible: false
minNodes: 0
maxNodes: 8
taints: gpu=batch:NoSchedule
labels: workload=batch
```

kevin: Looks good. For quotas, I'll request: 40 A10G GPUs and 32 H100 GPUs (start high to avoid repeated tickets). I'll include justification: PLG burst capacity + canary.

mike: One more thing — set `maxPodsPerNode` and `kubeReserved` appropriately. A10G nodes have 1 GPU and CPU pods; set `maxPods: 110`? test first. For H100, we should enable Multi-Instance GPU scheduling if provider supports fractional sharing, otherwise isolate with `device-plugin` and pod-level GPU requests.

anya: If quota request is approved we should create pools in a canary fashion: 2 a10g nodes first, verify GPU driver DS, then scale. I'll handle the DaemonSet smoke tests and share checklist.

deploy-bot: Deploy request created: `deploy-1998765432-setup-gw-usw3` by kevin. Status: pending manual approval. :rocket:

shreya: Approved for canary. Kevin — ping here when quota is approved and when you create the initial 2-node pool. I'll coordinate test prompts and evals. :thumbsup:

kevin: Filing quota ticket now (support case 234567). I'll update thread when provider responds. Thanks all. :eyes:
